ancestors.description: The folders above it, from the top; the root left out.

notes.description: Its @folder.md, whole; null for the root, or notes koan can't read.

parent_notes.description: Its parent's @folder.md, whole; null when the parent is the root, it is the root, or koan can't read them.

tasks.description: Its own open tasks, in tree order.

marker.description: The absolute path of the marker the folder was found by, or null.
